address: Moselstraße 15, Frankfurt on the Main, 60329, Germany
bio: Located in the centre of Bahnhofsviertel – a stone's throw from Moseleck, a legendary rustic pub – this pleasingly unpretentious establishment is a delightfully laid-back setting in which to savour good food or a cocktail. Dishes are designed for sharing. Options range from the hearty quail, demi-glace, flatbread (eating with your hands is allowed) to the more sophisticated crudo, blood orange, horseradish. Be sure to sample something from the cocktail menu! Yaldy, by the way, is a Scottish exclamation of excitement and enthusiasm. Tip: Definitely make a reservation – this place is always packed!...
